chunks: Al-Kulayni and a number of our companions, from Ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Daylami, from Harun ibn al-Jahm, from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) say:

When death approached al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon him), he said to al-Husayn (peace be upon him): 'O my brother, I am bequeathing to you a bequest, so preserve it. When I die, prepare me, then direct me toward the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) so that I may renew my covenant with him. Then turn me toward my mother (peace be upon her), then return me and bury me in al-Baqi'. And know that there will befall me from Aisha what God and the people know of her deeds and her enmity toward God and His Messenger, and her enmity toward us, the People of the Household.'

When al-Hasan (peace be upon him) passed away and was placed upon the bier, they carried him to the prayer-place of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) where he used to perform the funeral prayer. Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) performed the prayer over him, and he was carried and brought into the mosque. When he was brought to the grave of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), the one with the little eyes went to Aisha and said to her: 'They have brought al-Hasan to bury him alongside the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).'

She came out hastily upon a saddled mule — and she was the first woman to ride a saddle in Islam — and said: 'Move your son away from my house! He shall not be buried in my house and violate the privacy of the Messenger of God.' Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said to her: 'Long ago, you and your father violated the privacy of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), and brought into his house those whom he did not wish to be near him. And God will question you about that, O Aisha!'

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ: People of the Household — the Prophet's family, specifically used here for the Imams
key_terms.الْبَقِيع: Al-Baqi' — the cemetery in Medina adjacent to the Prophet's mosque where many Companions and family members are buried
key_terms.حِجَاب: Privacy/sanctity — the sacred boundary protecting the Prophet's household
key_terms.ذُو الْعُوَيْنَيْنِ: The one with the little eyes — a derogatory epithet used here for the spy who informed Aisha
key_terms.وَصِيَّة: Bequest, last will — a formal testamentary instruction from one dying to their heir

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Hasan say to Imam Husayn before his death about his burial?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated by Imam al-Baqir (AS) through Muhammad ibn Muslim, recounts the last will of Imam Hasan (AS) to his brother Imam Husayn (AS) regarding the burial rites and anticipated opposition from Aisha. It describes the dramatic events following Imam Hasan's death (50 AH), when Aisha rushed out on a saddled mule to prevent his burial near the Prophet's tomb in her house, prompting Imam Husayn's sharp rebuke reminding her of the historic violations committed by her and her father against the Prophet's sanctity and household.
